# MVX Audit 3.1.0

This release makes static extension review substantially more complete while
preserving MVX Audit's fail-closed, reproducible analysis contract.

Highlights:

- Adds bounded static analysis of manifest-declared Declarative Net Request
  rules, including redirects, header modification, disabled rulesets, precise
  evidence, comparison output, and offline verification.
- Adds bounded, non-executing analysis of literal Base64 `atob` payloads across
  JavaScript, HTML, SVG, and XML executable contexts with exact bundled parser
  versions and strict work limits.
- Adds identity-bound offline verification for audit, comparison, packed, and
  isolated-lab reports.
- Adds signed GitHub build-provenance and SBOM attestations, reproducible npm
  archives, CycloneDX SBOM assets, and SHA-256 checksums for releases.
- Expands the validated research corpus to 18 MV2/MV3 scenario pairs.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/hyj28/mvx-audit/blob/v3.1.0/CHANGELOG.md)
for the complete list of changes.
